frozen.deduplication: First ranked window per exact (path, qualified symbol) within the retrieved 50 windows.
frozen.packing: Ranked source prefixes, complete physical CR/LF lines; exact compact UTF-8 JSON including metadata and token_usage.
frozen.ties: SQLite distance/FTS score then snippet ID; equal-weight RRF then snippet ID.
frozen.cancellation: Cooperative between requests, embedding batches, and H2O calls; no single Metal-forward preemption.
frozen.abstention: Fit only declared development calibration rows; retain every calibration positive.
limits: Developer-authored source-reviewed queries; not representative user tasks.
Repository holdout applies to this evaluation, not model pretraining.
Token counts describe one compact tool payload, not provider billing.
Insufficient evidence does not prove behavior absent.
